say:1:1033327001:1.text: Five... I mean... three nickles for one!
say:1:1033327001:1.male: Five... I mean... three nickles for one!
say:1:1033327001:1.female: Five... I mean... three nickles for one!

say:2:1033327002:1.text: Well... Since there haven't had any foreign visitors for a while, I'll just give it to you for free then.
say:2:1033327002:1.source_cn: 唉，这段时间都没有外人来，就免费送你吧。
say:2:1033327002:1.male: Well... Since there haven't had any foreign visitors for a while, I'll just give it to you for free then.
say:2:1033327002:1.female: Well... Since there haven't had any foreign visitors for a while, I'll just give it to you for free then.

say:3:1033327003:1.text: Since the Thorned Guards sealed off the forest and expelled all outsiders, business has been even tougher.
say:3:1033327003:1.source_cn: 自从荆棘封锁丛林驱赶外来人，我的生意是越来越难了。
say:3:1033327003:1.male: Since the Thorned Guards sealed off the forest and expelled all outsiders, business has been even tougher.
say:3:1033327003:1.female: Since the Thorned Guards sealed off the forest and expelled all outsiders, business has been even tougher.

say:4:1033327004:1.text: Last time, I got mad at the Thorned Guards' tyranny and spoke out for a few refugees.
say:4:1033327004:1.source_cn: 上次我看不惯荆棘卫队的霸道，替难民说了两句公道话。
say:4:1033327004:1.male: Last time, I got mad at the Thorned Guards' tyranny and spoke out for a few refugees.
say:4:1033327004:1.female: Last time, I got mad at the Thorned Guards' tyranny and spoke out for a few refugees.

say:5:1033327005:1.text: They... they almost threw me in jail!
say:5:1033327005:1.source_cn: 结果……他们差点把我抓起来！
say:5:1033327005:1.male: They... they almost threw me in jail!
say:5:1033327005:1.female: They... they almost threw me in jail!
